nom: Neutrogena Hydro Boost Hyaluronic Acid Serum

avis.texte: Very Sticky and stays sticky on my face. Hard to get out of the bottle.
It makes my face smooth. Order it twice already. Wiĺl keep ordering it!
liked it. very light and hydrating. hard to take out when bottle runs low.

I reacted, but not everyone does! Proceed with caution, lovelies! I was having a bad reaction around my lips and eyes for a while. Couldnt figure out what it was for a long time, turned out to be this! If I put vaseline under my eyes and on/around my lips, I could use it. I ended up just using the rest as a spot treatment for really dry areas (nose, cheeks, forehead). My skin is sensitive, and it turned out it couldn't handle this very well, unfortunately! Just make sure to patch test beforehand, especially around sensitive skin like lips and around the eyes :) < 3

avis.titre: This is my fav. Prevents dry skin and I use it daily
avis.texte: Love this product. A must have for me. I enjoy using it daily and would recommends to use twice a day for soft hydrated skin. Been using this for years and it works well for my sensitive skin. Use this serum before all the other products. Easy to use not sticky.
i was happy i could get it local. makes face cleaned and fresh
I love using this under my favorite moisturizers. my skin has been so clear since I've started using this and a little goes a long way! it feels so refreshing too

I rarely return skin products but there was literally nothing I could do with this dehydrating sticky product. When used in conjunction with the water gel cream, I ended up with minor burns and breakouts on my face. It's a no.

Wanted to try a drugstore serum because skin care can be so expensive, but I regret it so much! Chemical burn and allergic reaction to this stuff. Felt like 🔥ant bites all over my chin and mouth area, as well as swollen lips and eyes.
I have struggled with dry skin, living in a cold winter climate. I cannot stand the smell of most moisturizing creams. This one has no scent and has kept all my dry skin fresh. Love it!

I have been using this product for a few weeks now with the rest of the product line and it works really well. The product sinks into the skin nicely and doesn't feel heavy or sticky. I have oily skin and throughout the day this product doesn't seem to enhance that. I feel very hydrated after using this product. I also have acne prone skin and so far have no issues with it increasing breakout or causing them. highly recommend using this product with the rest of the skin care line.
This product is so good for my skin. It moisturizes my skin so well. I would recommend this to everyone. I hope that you buy it. Definitely will be buying it again!😀😘😍
This serum feels very hydrating. It has a dropper and it's awesome. My skin feels a bit more plump after using this serum. I have dry skin and it suits it perfectly.

This product causes a terrible reaction on my skin: red itchy bumps, causes acne where I have never had acne, flakiness and dryness. Use caution because it doesn't show up immediately. I tested this product and it showed up about two days layer. It was the only new product I tried. I waited over a month and tried it again; the same thing happened. I do not recommend this product at all.
I usually love neutragena products this product made my eyes swollen and I developed little bumps will be returning

I have sensitive, dry skin with eczema! I wanted to give this a try in hopes it would help my dry skin! Absolutely not. Not only do I feel like it made my skin drier but it also burned within a few minutes of application. I ended up having to wash this off.
The dropper isnt the best. I feel like it's harder to get product out of the bottle by pressing the button on top. It side dispenses very little.
This has no foul smell and didnt iritate my extremely sensitive skin but it is SO sticky. even hours later I feel the stickiness on my face.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again.
avis.texte: It is honesty so amazing it works great for my skin pre before applying make up
Adds moisture! Really nice light scent! Not sticky! Would buy again!!!!!

I am 42, very very dry and very very sensitive skin. I struggle to find moisturizers that work and last. I use this under my daily moisturizer (Aveeno daily lotion). Now that I am getting a bit older I needed an extra boost, this has done the trick! I also use it at night under CeraV renewing night cream, they seem to clash and burns a bit but it doesn't seem to affect my skin.

avis.titre: There is better bank for your buck out there
avis.texte: Selena Gomez turned me onto trying this and in retrospect after my first bottle, I prefer ultra hydrating serums that get the job done. This serum was unfortunately sticky, fast drying, and too expensive to justify the average results it offers. There are $10 hydrating serums these days that will pack on the hydration and aid your dry patches so much better than this, seek elsewhere!

I love Neutrogena! I use the Hydro gel in addition to this and it makes my skin look and feel amazing! I was using the Honest Company's serums and creams, and they're great. BUT you can only purchase them online. So because of that, I've switched over to Neutrogena and I think I'm even happier!

This is honestly the worst product I have ever used. My skin burned the second I placed it on. I tried to give it a chance by testing in various stages of my skincare routine but it did not work. Waste of money.

I noticed around my cycle that my skin gets extremely dry and no matter how many times I reapply my moisturizer there's just a lack of moisture. I'm not a fan of adding too many layers to my skin care because it ends up clogging my pores in the process but I needed something ! So I tried this out and so far it's decent! What I love about this product is that it gives the hydration but its very light weight and feels like water 💧! I use before my moisturizer and before my night cream. I'll continue using for now

avis.titre: paired with a moisturizer on top - you have the dream team!
avis.texte: I use this everyday after my shower. Wet my face, apply and then add my moisturizer on after. It sucks the moisturizer into my skin and keeps it plump and soft to the touch all day! It's a noticeable difference. Does not have this effect if you use it alone!! Please apply a moisturizer layer last
I love this. I was having really bad dry, flaky skin and adding this underneath my moisturizer has made my skin 1000x better. The only downside is that it is a bit sticky.
I've used other neutrogena products before and have loved them but this one gave me an allergic reaction. It burned my skin and caused a horrible reaction to my eyelids.

I've been using this product for about 2 weeks and my skin already looks healthier and plumper! I have oily skin that gets dried out by acne medication. I bought this to try and combat the drying effect of my medication. It not only stopped the dryness, but made it healthier, plump, and youthful looking in a matter of two weeks! I will definitely be repurchasing this!

avis.titre: i will continue to buy this again and again
avis.texte: so i normally have oily skin but lately it's been on the dry side. used the ordinary hyaluronic acid serum, and while it was great, my skin was needing more moisture! a lady reccimmended this and it has helped my skin so much!! no more dry skin and it feels light to my areas that are oily!
I was suggested this product after telling employee my skin issues. She went over a lot of different products for me and said this one works great and it does!

avis.titre: Love it and my face is not oily
avis.texte: After a few uses I could tell the difference in how smooth my skin was. It gave it a great glow! Does not make your skin oily and I have had issues with that in the past! Love this product!
Absorbs fast and seems to be plumping and hydrating my skin nicely. I use it with another serum and a moisturizer morning and evening.
I've been using almost daily for two weeks! This stuff is amazing! Makes my skin feel soft and hydrated..and the price is reasonable too
This product is magic! I have extremely dry and sensitive skin and after using this my skin looks and feels amazing! Highly recommend! 10/10

I was liking how my skin felt until I woke up with a huge burn all over my chin. Took over a week to heal the horribly dry, cracked, and painful burn. Gave it 2 stars because it didn't burn the rest of my face so I might try again on just my cheeks and forehead but never again on my chin. Use with caution and in small amounts in case this happens to you.
I tried the trial size of this product and I experienced redness.

I've used other products in the hydro boost line with no issue for almost a year now, and I don't typically have issues with sensitive skin. However, this was new to me and I had an allergic reaction on my eye lids with this product. Will be returning

Initially I started to use this product for three days straight, day and night and in the beginning I was very impressed of how well this hyaluronic acid worked on the skin! It is truly very hydrating I'll tell you that! But after the second and third day I noticed a change in my skin, and usually when I experience a new negative change in my skin I try to acknowledge all the new products that I begin to use and this was the only new product I included in my skin routine due to the fact that I was empty out of my old hyaluronic acid. I bought this one due to its great reviews but unfortunately the high percentage of hyaluronic acid clog my pores...which led to break outs!

avis.titre: The answer to any dry skin!
avis.texte: I was leery about trying any new products on my skin. I have hormonal acne and use peroxide washes and a nightly retinoid under direction of my dermatologist and sensitive skin. But the drying effect of my current regimen needed an answer and moisturizer wasn't enough for the winter months. I tried this product and reading other reviews and WOW! My skin is noticeably less dry and stays moisturized longer, no more flaking halfway thru the day. And its very lightweight and has caused no irritation to my sensitive skin. The amount of product for the price is great as well. This will be part of my regimen now!

This has transformed my dry, parched skin! I have sensitive skin and have to be careful of what I use. Clinique Moisture Surge Night Mask was the only thing that worked until this! Plus half the price! I also notice my fine lines look better.

avis.titre: Have just bought my third bottle. Love it.
avis.texte: This serum keeps my skin moist all day long. Diminishes fine lines and wrinkles. I have just purchased my third bottle. I don't care for the eyedropper applicator. Surely, there is something better.
